claims: The 2026 UFL season features eight teams.
The eight teams follow a merger of the USFL and XFL.
The teams are organized into a single league.
The 2026 UFL teams are the Birmingham Stallions, Columbus Aviators, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm, and St. Louis Battlehawks.
Pro Football Newsroom notes AJ McCarron as head coach of the Birmingham Stallions.
The Columbus Aviators is a new franchise for 2026.
The Columbus Aviators is coached by Ted Ginn Jr.
The Dallas Renegades is formerly of the XFL.
The Dallas Renegades is led by Rick Neuheisel.
The DC Defenders is returning from the XFL.
The DC Defenders has head coach Shannon Harris.
The Houston Gamblers is a USFL legacy team.
The Houston Gamblers is coached by Kevin Sumlin.
The Louisville Kings is a new franchise for 2026.
The Louisville Kings is coached by Chris Redman.
The Orlando Storm is a new franchise for 2026.
The Orlando Storm has Anthony Becht as head coach.
The St. Louis Battlehawks is a high-attendance team from the XFL.
The St. Louis Battlehawks is coached by Ricky Proehl.
The 2026 UFL season officially kicked off in March.
